# SYNESIS_E088 — Error

## Description

`field_name: Label` — in ORDERED write the index (2); the label is display only.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The field 'field_name' was written with the label `Label`,
  but in `ORDERED` fields the data written is the INDEX. The index defines the
  order of the values and admits no spelling variants; the label is
  declared in the template and shown by the editor next to the index.
  Write `field_name: 2`.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **OrderedValueAsLabel**: `field_name`, `label`, `index`
